Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator prematurely narrowed the search to a small set of TripAdvisor-listed restaurants (“The Shack,” “Olio,” “Sneekers,” “Waterford Pizza Palace,” and “On the Waterfront”) instead of performing a comprehensive, map-based search filtered for Wednesday 11pm hours and then sorting by distance. This omission excluded closer late-night options like McDonald’s and led to selecting Sneekers Cafe without verifying the true closest open eatery.
